ops.title: project: IN-FLIGHT wave — cc-transcript full parser swap tree-sitter-bash → rable (Phase A2), then captain-hook Phase B rm-guard consumption; worktrees/oracle/gate locations + the exact contract + remaining sequence

ops.body:
**In-flight wave (2026-07-20).** Grew from a captain-hook ask ("nested payload rm→trash rewrite + structural `Command` + evaluate the regexes") into a **cc-transcript full shell-parser swap**. User made the calls via AskUserQuestion: (1) upstream tainted-payload handling in cc-transcript, not a captain-hook hack; (2) **full parser swap to `rable`** (0.2.1, MIT) over augment-tree-sitter, *accepting* the tradeoffs — rable spans are **char indices** (need a char→byte shim; `Word.PartialEq` includes span so it must be byte-exact) and it's a bus-factor-1 dep — to enumerate tainted payloads structurally + delete the heredoc-recovery cluster. Byte-offset gate FAILED for every swap candidate (rable/brush char-indexed; yash-syntax/flash/mystsh GPL; cv/bash-ast GPL+FFI+no-spans); only tree-sitter passes — user chose rable anyway.

**Why the swap is feasible (spike-proven, `/tmp/rable-spike/`):** rable is a Rust crate inside cc-transcript's own `rust/crates/core` (its sexp-only Python binding is irrelevant — cc-transcript has its OWN PyO3 layer). char→byte map is a 5-liner (verified on `rm café.txt` → bytes 3..12). Taint = any `Word.parts` is an expansion kind. `$()`/backtick auto-reparse (depth-2 cap vs current 3). Native multi-heredoc → **deletes the ~140-line heredoc-recovery cluster**. rable does NOT dequote or expose quote-layer/`expandable` → reuse cc-transcript's existing `dequote` + re-scan the raw word slice's leading quote.

**State / locations (REBASED v14.6.1 → v14.7.0 on 2026-07-20):** a concurrent push moved cc-transcript main to **v14.7.0** (`3d7abb9`, tagged + on PyPI): +240 lines in `command.rs` adding `Command.split_options` (over words) + **arity-aware, six-bypass-hardened wrapper unwrap** (both in the KEEP-machinery — the parser swap sits on top). The port rebased onto v14.7.0.
- Isolated cc-transcript worktree: **`/private/tmp/cct-rable-147` @ v14.7.0** (origin/main `3d7abb9`). (Stale v14.6.1 worktree `/private/tmp/cct-rable` — remove.) ⚠️ WORKING COPY `/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-transcript` is v14.2.0 — edit the worktree, not it.
- Differential oracle: **`/tmp/cct_golden.json`** (117 lines, dumped from released **14.7.0** via `/tmp/cct147venv`, incl. wrapper-arity cases) + gate **`/tmp/cct_diff.py`** (0 REGRESSIONS required; 7 INTENDED tainted `-c`/`eval` lines may change — they gain the inner enumerated occurrence). Regenerate the oracle from the SAME cc-transcript the port targets.
- Port lane: agent `cct-rable-port` (opus) rewriting `rust/crates/core/src/command.rs` (1926 lines).
- `tree-sitter`/`tree-sitter-bash` are **feature-gated** behind the optional `command` feature → clean swap (`command = ["dep:rable"]`). Core stays edition 2021 (rable edition-2024 is internal; rustc 1.97.1). Keep parser-agnostic machinery: `dequote`/`splice`/`embeddable`/`quote_for`/`prefix`/`runs`/wrapper-strip/PyO3.

**The one intended change:** tainted payload (`bash -c "rm $F"`, double-quoted-with-expansion) currently bails (`command.rs:1024`, value=None) → 1 occurrence; NEW = dequote raw + re-parse via rable → inner `rm` enumerated as a **span-less (span=None → splice refuses = non-rewritable), nesting+1** occurrence. Clean single-quoted payloads already enumerate — keep identical.

**Remaining sequence:** A2 port → differential green → **release cc-transcript 14.7.0 (CONFIRM with user before push)** → Phase B captain-hook: delete ALL manual descent (`descend_rm`/`nested_command_string`/`SHELL_C_FLAG`) + obsolete regex helpers (`SAFE_WORD`/`unescape_shell`/`emit_token`/`plain_words`/`normalize_executable`); uniform occurrence-based rm-guard (clean nested → trash-rewrite via occurrence splice; tainted span-less → block-only); walker scope-aware cwd.

**captain-hook progress (worktree `.claude/worktrees/ch-wave-wt`, pin already `>=14.6.1`):** B2 dual-mode `Command` (structural vs regex, `nesting==0` pin) DONE + green; `executable_name` landed in `util/shell.py`. B3/B4/B5 pending A2. Golden rm-guard baseline: `/tmp/rm_baseline_before.txt` (intended change: `sudo bash -c 'rm /foo.txt'` deny→trash-rewrite). Related: [[cct-payload-word-primitives-shipped]] [[cctranscript-1460-command-primitives-shipped]] [[rm-trash-rewrite-shipped]].

**Lane note:** codex/`codex-ask` UNAVAILABLE this session (not just usage-limited) → all lanes on Claude (opus/fable).
